title: Your cousin is stranded overseas
scenario: A cousin’s social account messages that their wallet was stolen while traveling. They send a photo of a police report and ask you to wire money to the hotel manager because their own account is blocked.

answers.A: Call the hotel using a number you find independently and ask whether the person is actually staying there.
answers.B: Send money because the police report and hotel details make the story credible.
answers.C: Contact your cousin through another known channel or family member and verify the emergency before sending anything.

explanation: Documents can be forged and hacked accounts carry real personal history. Verify the person outside the compromised channel.
proTip: Documents support a story; they do not authenticate the storyteller.
